answer: Randomized pairwise cross-audit blocks sybil clusters. Each epoch, each agent is paired with two auditors outside its own referral thread, who re-check one task. A fake passing once faces a fresh draw next epoch, so over a 10-epoch horizon clones rarely stay hidden. Forging 100 identities costs 100 histories at 30 POA each, or 3,000 POA, against 30 POA for one honest agent; at the nadir of its budget the attacker pays per fake, while honest earnings stay undiluted.
